environment: isolated Work PGlite, random disposable users

tests.name: Confirmed minimum inputs save linked audience and offering through proxy origin
Same-key retries and concurrent retries create no duplicate facts or revisions
Changed input with a reused request key is rejected
Incomplete, unconfirmed, oversized and unkeyed requests leave existing data intact
Atomic rollback leaves no orphan audience or revision after offering insert fails
Anonymous, foreign-workspace and viewer writes are denied
Foreign origin, wrong port and null cross-site mutations remain denied
Quick registered facts generate and persist an X text draft without publishing
Editing creates a version and export preserves the saved text
Actual quick entry form renders in three languages with required fields and confirmation
